message: `u64` is a type VARIABLE here, not a type
label: this binds a fresh type variable named `u64`
help: write `Int`. A lowercase name in type position is a TYPE VARIABLE, and there is no such thing as an unknown one - so this signature does not constrain anything, it generalises over it and accepts a value of any type at all. Axiom has one integer type, `Int`, 64 bits wide, and one float, `Float`. The narrow spellings belong on the Rust side of an `extern` block, where the boundary widens them - see docs/ffi.md; they are not Axiom types. The uppercase near-misses are refused already: `Double` and `I64` draw AX3002, because an unknown UPPERCASE name is an unknown type constructor. `u64` is lowercase, which is the whole difference.
